articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: JPMorgan Taps New COO To Unify AI And Data For Investors. JPMorgan Chase has appointed Guy Halamish as Chief Operating Officer for its commercial and investment bank. Halamish will oversee a broad overhaul of the bank's AI and data strategy across payments, global banking, securities, and markets. The move signals a push to embed AI, cleaner data, and tighter governance into JPMorgan's core operations.
